newsitem.title: USA: Affinity sees Q3 revs below Q2.
newsitem.headline: Affinity sees Q3 revs below Q2.

text.p: Affinity Technology Group Inc said Wednesdya after the market closed that it expects third quarter revenues to be "significantly" below the second quarter.
The figures from the second quarter were not immediately available.
Affinity cited longer-than-expected sales cycles and increased investment in new delivery channels for the shortfall.
The company also said it has reached an agreement a consumer finance company to install 50 of its automated loan machines in major retail outlets and other consumer venues.
